evidence_snippets: Call Google Cloud APIs with the service identity When a Cloud Run instance interacts with other IAM-authenticated Cloud Run services, or calls Cloud Client Libraries either through application code or built-in features like Cloud Run integrations or Cloud Storage volume mounts , the Google Cloud environment uses Application Default Credentials (ADC) to automatically detect whether the Cloud Run service identity is authenticated to perform the API operation.
Examples of Google Cloud products that have Cloud Client Libraries include Cloud Storage, Firestore, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Tasks.
